blocks.h: Why agencies use an India-based partner, and when not to
paras: Agencies abroad use an India-based partner for practical reasons: several disciplines from one team, work that moves while their own office is closed, and room to add services without hiring for each.

It is the wrong choice in some cases, and we would rather say so first. If your client needs someone in the room every week, if the work must be written by native speakers of the client's language, or if your contracts require client data to stay in one country, a local partner or a hire may suit you better. The same applies if your team cannot spare the time to write clear briefs and review work on a fixed rhythm.

stages.breaks: Having no hours when both teams are online.
